text: Products can be returned if they are undamaged and complete. You are allowed to try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. For returns, the order number is sufficient; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, return requests are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. Return shipping is free if done through the contracted carrier Anadolu Kargo using the provided return code; if you use your own carrier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. After the product arrives at the warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are made to the account holder's IBAN number.
